{{Short description|German mathematician}}

'''Jan Kohlhaase''' (born 1976)<ref name="KAG">{{cite journal|url=https://www.uni-due.de/unikate/pdf/UNIKATE_2019_053_02_Kohlhaase.pdf|journal=Unikate|accessdate=2022-09-04|title=Kammern, Apartments, Gebäude|author=Jan Kohlhaase|date=1992 |doi=10.17185/duepublico/23613 }}</ref> is a German mathematician specialising in the [[representation theory]] of [[Lie group#Related concepts|p-adic Lie groups]] and [[arithmetic geometry]].<ref name="ESAGA">{{cite web|url=https://www.esaga.uni-due.de/jan.kohlhaase/|title=Prof. Dr. Jan Kohlhaase|work=esaga.uni-due.de|accessdate=2022-09-04}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
From 1997 to 2002, Kohlhaase studied mathematics and physics at the [[University of Hamburg]] and at [[Purdue University]].<ref name="Pressemitteilung">{{cite web|url=https://www.uni-due.de/de/presse/meldung.php?id=8532|title=Prof. Dr. Jan Kohlhaase ist neu an der UDE – Pressemitteilung der Universität Duisburg-Essen|accessdate=2022-09-04|work=uni-due.de}}</ref> In 2005 he obtained his [[PhD]] at the [[University of Münster]] under the supervision of [[Peter Schneider (mathematician)|Peter Schneider]].<ref name="MGP">{{cite web|url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=91336|work=Mathematics Genealogy Project|title=Jan Kohlhaase|accessdate=2022-09-04}}</ref><ref name="Dissertation">{{cite web|url=https://d-nb.info/975535390/34|title=Invariant distributions on p-adic analytic groups|author=Jan Kohlhaase|accessdate=2022-09-04}}</ref> He subsequently worked at [[Institut des Hautes Etudes Scientifiques|IHES]], the University of Münster as well as the [[Heidelberg University|University of Heidelberg]]. Kohlhaase [[Habilitation|habilitated]] at the University of Münster in 2011, and was appointed professor for arithmetic geometry at the [[University of Duisburg-Essen]] in 2014.<ref name="Pressemitteilung"/>
